text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I had a great run in the Hyacinth Stakes! 
Just when I thought I could keep stanning 
without being a bother... the Umamusume 
next to me is crying?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
When someone wins, someone else loses... 
As long as I'm in the race, I can't just 
be a bystander. ...It took me a while, but 
I've finally made up my mind!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
To honor the girl whose dream was broken, 
I must become stronger! I'll prove on the 
next stage just how strong Digi-tan truly 
was. Look forward to the next episode, 
《To the NHK Mile Cup》...!
